Description

The next generation of premium speed cube is here! The GAN 16 3x3 Max (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets, UV Coated) sets the bar for 3x3 speed cubes and delivers performance appreciated by speedcubers of all skill levels.

UV Coating

  • Super glossy plastic, high grip

Core Magnets

  • Corner-to-core magnets for a better, more controllable turning feel
  • 40-degree auto-alignment
  • Increased stability

MagLev

  • Fastest turning feel
  • Spring replaced by repelling magnets
  • Magnetic levitation technology

Key features

  • Enhanced core positioning 4.0 auto-aligning technology (40 degrees)
  • New center piece design to minimize lock-ups and friction
  • New magnetic layout
  • 72 adjustment setting combinations

Customers say

Customers praised this flagship 3x3 as "buttery smooth" and "incredibly fast" with exceptional customization options including adjustable magnets and tension settings. While described as "worth every penny" for serious speedcubers, some noted the high price point and slippery UV coating. Reviews highlighted impressive corner cutting, stability, and MagLev performance.

AI-powered review summary based on recent customer reviews

Review highlights


C
Charlie S.
08/11/2025

Somehow better than 15

I was a Gan tester for this product, and it is AMAZING. This cube has edge-to-center magnets, that have never been in a cube before. Because of them, this cube has insane auto alignment. The cube also has a new design for the edges, making it almost unpopable. You can loosen it a ton and it will still not pop. It is a great cube for all types of solvers. If you like a very fast cube, , this is the fastest in the world, because of how much you can loosen it without it coming apart use weak magnets too. Or, if you want a control cube, tighten it, and add stronger magnets. I have mine pretty loose, with medium magnets. I usually use Lunar, or Martian and Lunar for my cubes. This cube you can have so loose without coming apart I use Galaxy or maybe even a thicker lube. With Galaxy and it moderately loose, it becomes the most satisfying and smooth/fast amazing cube ever! All MoYu or Tornado lovers, it may be time to get a Gan. IT IS WORTH EVERY BUCK. (Even if I got mine for free). The tensions and magnetic rods are the same as the 15. The rods are the same colors, but have a white plastic covering the magnets, making them look better. It also has a very similar tool, except this one is white instead of clear dark blue. I like the blue better, but it does not really matter. It does make a clicking sound when turning though. Satisfying, but can get annoying after a couple hundred solves in one sitting. By far, best 3x3. Buy it.
